feature_descriptions.path benefit: Gain the path benefit from each of the two selected Hedgewitch paths.
feature_descriptions.path power: Gain the path power from each of the two selected Hedgewitch paths.
feature_descriptions.path secrets: The selected paths add their associated secrets to the legal Hedgewitch Secret choices.
feature_descriptions.path mastery: At 20th level, gain the mastery of each selected Hedgewitch path.

choice_providers.label: Hedgewitch Paths
choice_providers.description: Choose two paths at 1st level. Their class skills, benefits, powers, secret lists, and 20th-level masteries are retained in the class rules and Codex.

choice_providers.label: Hedgewitch Secrets
choice_providers.description: Choose one general or path secret at every even level. Grand secrets become legal at 10th level; path-specific options remain governed by the two selected paths.

notes: The normal sphere spell-point service remains authoritative. Paths and secrets are persisted by the shared class-choice system; their complete rules are available from the selected feature detail and Codex.
